gap_calibration: Nonnegative seasonal affine least squares, fitted only to training observed discharge and two-day-lagged GRRR; predictions clipped to zero. Never extrapolate past archive coverage, even with a lagged value available.
common_window_policy: Same origins and observed targets in both arms; latest input observed, >=15 observed input dates in 30 days; full target window inside chronological split. Filling adds no extra scored origins.
checkpoint_selection: Observed validation MSE only; filled validation targets never used.
primary_metric: RMSE pooled across the same observed origin-target-lead pairs

bootstrap.method: Paired circular moving blocks over complete target-date calendar, retaining all leads together; no synthetic target rows.

retention: Keep the NaN arm unless every clear-win criterion passes. Retain experimental predictions/reports for audit but do not select failed filled checkpoint.
scope: Retrospective research; historical publication latency, GRRR pretraining overlap, point-vs-daily-mean measurement equivalence, and operational availability are not established. No operational skill claim.
